name: budget re-check per slice — the remaining budget is surfaced in plain Arabic before anything is spent, and an at-cap project cannot silently start a new slice (PHASE-56 W-3, R-5)
description: PHASE-56 W-3, ruling R-5. budgetStatus is an ADDITIVE export in budget_enforcer.js reusing the SAME numbers the cap itself reads — ledger.getTotalCost plus PHASE-55 W-1's legacy _legacy_stage_a spend under the R-21 first-activity lifetime bound, against the vision's max_total_usd — nothing is re-derived. Asserts: (a) budgetStatus reports cap/spent/remaining/pct and its allow/deny boundary AGREES with checkBudget on the same project, and its spent figure includes a legacy sentinel row booked after the project's first activity; (b) an at-or-over-cap project asking for more work is refused with the numbers inside result.message (R-26), and NOTHING happens — no new loop, no status change, no slice appended, and crucially NO provider call (the agent ledger gains zero rows), so the refusal cannot itself cost the owner money; (c) an under-cap project's slice proposal carries the remaining figure in its message; (d) checkBudget's own verdicts are unchanged for a known-good and a known-over project, so agent_budget_rule.js is provably unaffected.
